title: Theme System — Tailwind v4 CSS, ThemeProvider, MobX ThemeStore
description: Create the Tailwind v4 CSS-first theme system with @theme design tokens, @custom-variant dark for class-based dark mode, a ThemeProvider React context, and a MobX ThemeStore for reactive theme state. Replace the existing base.css with a comprehensive app.css using @theme directive for colors, spacing, typography, and shadows.
acceptance_criteria: @theme directive defines design tokens (colors, spacing, typography, shadows) in app.css
@custom-variant dark uses (&:where(.dark, .dark *)) for class-based dark mode
ThemeStore (MobX) toggles theme and persists to localStorage
ThemeProvider wraps app and applies/removes 'dark' class on document root
CSS custom properties are accessible via Tailwind utility classes
TypeScript strict mode passes with no errors
